transcript: What? This is insane. I have never seen AI directing movies like this before. To make this film, I went to OpenArt Director Mode and then selected Short Film. I just gave it my rough idea, select the video style, and then the duration to 5 minutes. Then the vibe director turned my concept into a full storyboard, keeping every single shot consistent across every scene—same character, same voice, and location. Then just click on Looks Good!. Once you get a full video, now you can edit each scene. Like add a different character if you like, change the location, or add multiple objects. Or even trimming and adding a completely new scene in the film. It's way easier than switching multiple models or even editing video in the post-production. And if you want to watch the complete film, just drop a follow, and I'll post in the next one.
caption:
